description: This file defines the Response class and related functions for handling and rendering responses in a Playwright-based system, including capturing snapshots, managing results, errors, images, files, and serializing responses with support for markdown and meta information.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Manages response data including results, code, images, files, and snapshots; provides methods to add data, render responses, and serialize content.

classes.name: RenderedResponse
classes.description: Represents a formatted response with methods to generate text, meta, and handle redaction.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a CallToolResult object to extract structured response data based on markdown sections.

methods.name: renderTabSnapshot
methods.description: Renders a tab snapshot into the response, including console messages, downloads, and page state.

methods.name: renderTabsMarkdown
methods.description: Generates markdown list of open tabs, optionally forcing display.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending ellipsis if needed.
